verdict.rationale: API clients like Bruno could plausibly offer their own scoped, least-privilege credentials for agents, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Bruno issuing such credentials. The closest items are secret variables and vaults, OAuth client-credentials auth for calling other APIs, and AI governance on the Ultimate Edition. These are adjacent features for consuming third-party APIs or managing AI providers, not credential issuance, and the product is offline-only with no accounts.
